title: Kernel Neural Optimal Transport
tldr_zh: 证明 NOT 在 gamma-weak 二次 cost 下鞍点含大量 fake solution，改用特征核 weak cost 后所有鞍点都是 OT plan；翻译 FID 与稳定性改善
tldr_en: NOT with the gamma-weak quadratic cost admits many fake saddle points; characteristic-kernel weak costs make every optimal saddle point a true OT plan and improve I2I FID and stability.
key_numbers: Test FID 128px kernel vs weak-quadratic NOT: outdoor->church 15.16 vs 25.97, celeba(f)->anime 21.96 vs 28.21, handbags->shoes 26.7 vs 33.9 (Table 1)
Test FID 128px vs baselines: outdoor->church 15.16 vs CycleGAN 36.16-43.74, MUNIT 32.14, AugCycleGAN 51.15; texture->shoes 24.84 vs CycleGAN 34.65, MUNIT 43.74 (Table 5)
Stability (32px, 5 seeds): weak quadratic gamma=2 best/last/max FID 25.36/37.18/67.50 vs kernel gamma=2 16.50/20.19/29.85 on shoes->handbags (Table 3)
Kernel choice texture->handbags 64px FID: bilinear 18.79, distance 16.13, Gaussian 20.89, Laplacian 20 (Fig. 14)
Fake saddle points exist iff Proj_{<=Q}((1/gamma) P) != Q; characteristic kernel + gamma in (0,1] makes all optimal saddle points OT plans (Corollary 1, Theorem 2)
Compute: 3-4 days on 4x V100 for 128px (Appendix I)
